text:
Jordan: heads up — Customer ACME wants a 45% discount for a 6-week POC, will commit to MRR if successful. Need dealdesk route and a fast path, opp: https://redwood.salesforce.com/opp/0063Z00001example :eyes:
Maria: thanks. is this a paid POC or free? does ACME require data retention or custom infra?
Jordan: paid POC, billed. No infra changes, but they asked for a short-term commit credit if they convert.
Frank (DealDesk): 45% is outside standard thresholds. We can auto-route to FastPass approval but need two things: 1) CPQ flags set on the opp 2) SLA TTL for auto-escalation. Recommend Approval_Mode__c=FastPass and Approval_TTL_minutes__c=2880 (48h).
Maria: 48h escalation acceptable. Can we tie the fallback to SalesOps manager if no response?
Frank (DealDesk): yes — escalation path: Approver -> Approver.manager -> SalesOps.Manager. I'll add that to the routing matrix. Also need fields: Special_Terms__c="POC credit on conversion", Commit_Retention__c="30d"
Jordan: also need to avoid full security review for speed — this is only metadata and no PII. tagging eng-security. @Sasha can we waive the security questionnaire for this specific POC? :pray:
Sasha (eng-security): quick context: we can do a scoped waiver if data residency & persistence are constrained. Need NDA signed + confirmation that logs are scrubbed. Send the short checklist: https://redwood.internal/sec/poc-waiver-checklist
Maria: we have NDA in place. ACME agreed to no persistent logs.
Sasha (eng-security): ok — mark Security_Review_Required__c=false on the opp and attach waiver doc. I'll approve the waiver in 24h.
Frank (DealDesk): great. here's the CPQ snippet I'll apply (we'll run as an opt-in automation):
```
// CPQ field updates (pseudo)
Opportunity.Deal_Approval_Mode__c = "FastPass"
Opportunity.Approval_TTL_minutes__c = 2880
Opportunity.Special_Terms__c = "POC credit on conversion; 6-week POC"
Opportunity.Security_Review_Completed__c = true
```
Eileen (SalesOps): FYI I'll create the approval task and set TTL timer. We have an SLA: DealDesk initial review within 4h, approver response within 24-48h. If approver doesn't act, auto-escalate with email + slack ping.
Jordan: perfect. Frank, can you also add a note for billing that POC invoice will be standard, credit applied on conversion?
Frank (DealDesk): noted. I'll add Billing_Note__c and set Commit_Credit_Flag__c=true.
deals-bot: approval request created for Opportunity 0063Z00001example. TTL=2880m. Current approver: @Liam.
Liam: looks fine from my side, but I need the waiver doc attached before I approve.
Jordan: uploaded waiver to opp and linked it in comments.
Sasha (eng-security): attached. waiving full review — approving security flag now.
Liam: thanks. approving now. :thumbsup:
Frank (DealDesk): approval recorded. routing closed. I'll follow up if billing needs anything else.
Jordan: awesome — thanks team! :tada:
